rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for carrying out an action, court judgment, or computer instruction; it emphasizes the process rather than whether the result was successful.

example.english: The execution of the court order went smoothly.
example.traditional: 執行法庭命令嘅過程好順利。
example.jyutping: zap1 hang4 faat3 ting4 ming6 ling6 ge3 gwo3 cing4 hou2 seon6 lei6

rows.note: Use this when “execution” means capital punishment or the death penalty, rather than the general carrying out of an order.

example.english: The prisoner's execution took place at dawn.
example.traditional: 嗰名囚犯朝早畀人執行死刑。
example.jyutping: go2 ming4 cau4 faan2 ziu1 zou2 bei2 jan4 zap1 hang4 sei2 jing4

rows.note: Use this when “execution” highlights that a mission or task was successfully accomplished.

example.english: The execution of the project was finally completed.
example.traditional: 我哋終於完成咗個項目。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 jyun4 sing4 zo2 go3 hong6 muk6
